name: Mercury Trade Links Limited
about: Mercury Trade Links Limited engages in the trading of agricultural products. It offers fertilizers; manures; plant or animal foods; and pesticides, including insecticides, herbicides, and fungicides; as well as rice, maize, milo, seeds, cotton seeds, soya beans, ground nuts, castors, linseeds, sunflower, coconut, rapeseed, almond, sesamum, mustard, and sea seed, grapeseed products. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
